product_copy.disclaimer_en: Leave figures reflect Kuwait private-sector Labour Law research for software operation. Wathefni does not provide legal advice and does not claim automatic legal compliance. Balance enforcement is off until counsel review and an explicit product flip.
product_copy.disclaimer_ar: أرقام الإجازات مبنية على بحث قانون العمل للقطاع الأهلي لتشغيل البرمجيات. وثفني لا تقدّم استشارة قانونية ولا تدّعي الامتثال التلقائي. إنفاذ الأرصدة متوقف حتى مراجعة قانونية وتفعيل صريح.
product_copy.eligibility_rule_en: Annual leave: at least 30 paid working days per year; first-year leave may be taken after 6 months of service (Law 6/2010 Art. 70 as amended by Law 85/2017).
product_copy.payroll_boundary_en: Leave records day bands and paid/unpaid classification inputs only. Payroll owns monetary values and salary fractions.
product_copy.holiday_contract_en: Fixed Gregorian holidays may be versioned with provenance. Islamic/decree holidays require official yearly announcement load, review, and approval. Unreviewed dates fail closed for enforced calculations.
